comment: Independent C-first human Valkyrie with DECgraphics. '/' then '/' picks from the map; 'j' moves onto the bottom wall and ':' looks there. pager.c do_look() prints the line with putmixed(); its first byte is S_hwall's 0xF1, which topl.c redotoplin() prints through g_putch() as the DEC 'q', and the short line leaves room for getpos()'s 'Pick a monster, object or location.' on the same row. 'k' (step 7) moves back onto the hero: getpos.c auto_describe() writes through custompline(SUPPRESS_HISTORY) and show_topl(), whose home() and cl_end() replace column 0, so the row starts with 'h'. A second ':' looks at the hero and Escape leaves.
